title: Protect unsaved editorial notes during server comparison
summary: Notes-only edits now require confirmation before loading server text; recovery compares revision as well as version and source.

changes.detail: Canceling server replacement preserves bilingual notes and the local recovery record.
A recovered revision mismatch opens explicit server comparison without upgrading the save guard.
Regression tests for notes-only cancellation/confirmation and revision-only mismatch.
